profile.headline: Retired
profile.summary: Skilled in design, implementation and test of small to large software projects in Linux with C and C++, Java, git, CVS, Tcl, Expect, Perl, Python, SQL, GUI development, XML/RPC and shell.  Knowledgeable in SPARC, PowerPC, and ARM processors and SoC's.  Strong engineering professional with a MS focused in Computer Science from University of Wisconsin at Madison.

positions.title: Senior Staff Engineer
positions.description: Technical lead for an instruction set simulator for ARM v7 and v8 with high fidelity to specific Samsung implementations. This C++ model is used for RTL verification and for creating instruction traces of benchmarks, which are input to the cycle-accurate model for analysis. Responsible for initial design and much of the initial implementation of the model. Also responsible for making improvements and adding new ARM features, and implementing new requirements from users. Primary contact between model development team and RTL verification team, which is the primary customer for this model.

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description:
*) Worked on a team designing and building VPE, a new hardware functional modeling tool written in Java using agile development practices.  After putting together the instruction test environment, was actively involved in the design of the PowerPC core component and had primary responsibility for POWER7 register and instruction set implementation and Linux/AIX bring-up.  VPE was designed to replace an older simulator currently in use which was becoming increasingly difficult to maintain; VPE also eliminated reliance on third-party simulation support.

*) Worked on Wind River Simics/Python/bash scripting and device/component modeling in support of a future IBM product that utilizes the Freescale P4080 SoC.  Responsible for support of Linux kernel and driver developers who need modeling environments with a variable number of P4080s along with a varying list of proprietary IBM components.

positions.title: Engineering Technical Staff
positions.description:
*) Primarily responsible for integration and release of P4080 and other QorIQ-based SoC models.  These cycle-accurate C/C++ models are designed to work with functional models developed by 3rd parties.  Worked closely with Virtutech (now Wind River) to define, implement and maintain C++ and Python APIs for co-simulation of Freescale modeling IP with Simics.  Developed framework for regression testing of these models.

*) Responsible for team infrastructure, including web pages (HTML, JavaScript, PHP), databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL), build environment and regression monitoring.

*) Designed and implemented a Tcl-based command line front-end for communicating via XML/RPC with a variety of simulators running as daemons.

*) Helped to develop and maintain a custom MySQL database that captures architectural data related to the PowerPC instruction set and allows for auto-generation of a large percentage of instruction handling code for numerous PowerPC implementations via Perl scripts which I created. 

*) Actively participated in the development of functional models of the Power architecture, including the MPC603E, MPC7445, e300, e500, and e600 implementations, to provide a complete software enablement platform, working directly with hardware designers to ensure model correctness.
